name: Ashraf Ali Thanwi
role: Deobandi scholar and religious-social reform influence
contribution: His writings and guidance influenced religious discipline, everyday ethics, and reformist practice among South Asian Muslims.
context: In late colonial India, his Deobandi scholarly network and reform literature circulated widely and informed debates over Muslim social conduct and religious authority.
impact: He became a major religious-social reform reference for Muslim communities and scholars across South Asia, including Bengal.
highlight: A major influence on religious discipline and social reform in South Asian Islam.
seoTitle: Ashraf Ali Thanwi: Deobandi Scholar and Reformer
seoDescription: Explore Ashraf Ali Thanwi's Deobandi scholarship, reform literature, and influence on Muslim social thought in South Asia.
shortAnswer: Ashraf Ali Thanwi was a Deobandi scholar whose writings influenced religious practice and social reform across South Asia.
